project_type: Next.js 15 App Router + Prisma + PostgreSQL — ENT location intelligence service with admin UI
build_system: Next.js 15 with standard next build. No monorepo. Build command also runs `prisma generate` via postinstall.
test_framework: None configured — verification is done via `npm run build` (TypeScript compile + Next.js build).
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from /Users/apple/Documents/ent-location-sys. Build must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors. Schema changes require `npm run db:push` before the build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/schema.prisma changes require running `npm run db:push` which also regenerates the Prisma client. No other generated files are checked in.
environment_constraints: GEMINI_API_KEY must be set in .env.local for Gemini calls to work at runtime; not needed for build. DATABASE_URL must be set for db:push.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns: Google flat design (border-gray-200, #1a73e8 primary, no shadows, no rounded-xl), server component + client component split for admin pages, await auth() for admin routes, await checkApiKey(req) for v1 routes.
key_patterns: Admin API routes: import { auth } from '@/lib/auth', call `const session = await auth()`, return 401 if null. V1 API routes: `const authError = await checkApiKey(req); if (authError) return authError;`. Admin UI: server component fetches data via prisma, passes serialized props to 'use client' component. Docs page: uses `headers()` from 'next/headers' to build baseUrl dynamically; uses EndpointSection, CodeBlock, Badge, BaseUrlBanner components from @/components/docs/.
directory_structure: src/app/api/v1/ — public API routes (checkApiKey guard). src/app/api/admin/ — admin API routes (auth() guard). src/app/admin/ — admin Next.js pages (server+client split). src/app/docs/ — public API docs page. src/components/admin/ — admin UI components including sidebar. src/components/docs/ — docs page components (EndpointSection, CodeBlock, Badge, BaseUrlBanner, DocsSidebar). src/lib/ — shared server libs (prisma, auth, api-auth, ai-matching, condition-matcher). prisma/ — schema.prisma and seed scripts.
